prompt: Create a premium editorial dark-fantasy illustration for Narrative Framework, an open-source tabletop RPG campaign organizer. Artwork only: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, letters, labels, logos or UI. Wide 3:2 canvas. A rugged mature human male ranger with a short dark beard and scarred weathered face, heavy wool cloak and practical worn leather armor, together with a stocky older male dwarf companion with a thick braided grey beard, steel pauldrons and a travel-worn coat. They plan an expedition over a map on a rough stone table inside an abandoned mountain gatehouse. One hand holds a sealed letter, small clue tokens and an unlabelled folded map imply GM secrets and interconnected plots. In the background through a broken arch, a monumental ruined fortress among misty pine-covered mountains. Grounded adult sword-and-sorcery, thoughtful and determined characters, masculine ruggedness, restrained heroic composition, no cartoon, no sexualization, no gore. Fine etched ink/woodcut contour work with rich painterly surfaces, like a beautifully illustrated mature RPG sourcebook, refined detailed faces, strong readable silhouettes. Charcoal and deep forest #151d1b shadows, cold slate and iron grey, warm ivory highlights, limited burnt copper/rust glints from one lantern. Muted, tactile, dramatic, no glowing magic, no purple, no glossy game-render look. Keep the two faces and map inside the central 85% of frame; edges can fade into dark forest charcoal to sit above native typography on a poster. Genuine illustrated scene, no decorative poster border, no text at all.
